## Product Strategy Brief **Adaptive‑Learning Platform – Global Core + Local 4‑World Stack** **Target Markets** – Vietnam, Saudi Arabia, France, Kenya **Timeline** – 2026‑2028 (2‑year go‑to‑market program) --- ### 1. High‑Level Vision > Deliver a **single, AI‑driven adaptive‑learning engine** that powers **four distinct product “skins”**—each compliant with local curriculum mandates, language rules, parental & teacher expectations, and procurement ecosystems—while keeping a **shared tech core** (~70 % of codebase) to accelerate scale and control cost. --- ## 2. Core Architecture (Shared Technology Layer) | Layer | Responsibility | Key Capabilities | Shared Across All Markets | |-------|----------------|------------------|---------------------------| | **1️⃣ Adaptive Engine** | Learner state, mastery modeling, decision‑making | Bayesian network + reinforcement learning → personalized pacing | • Algorithms (open‑source + proprietary)
• API layer for content injection | | **2️⃣ Content Delivery API** | Content storage, metadata, sequencing | JSON‑based assets, localization tags, media streaming | • Asset repository (cloud)
• Asset‑push/monitoring | | **3️⃣ Analytics & Reporting** | Real‑time dashboards, learning analytics, A/B testing | LMS analytics engine, GDPR‑ready data lake | • Core reporting framework
• Consent management engine | | **4️⃣ Security & Compliance** | User authentication, data encryption, privacy controls | Multi‑tenant auth, role‑based access | • IAM, SSO, encryption keys | | **5️⃣ Plug‑in Interface** | Locale‑specific extensions | SDK for curriculum / assessment modules | • Extension registry, versioning | **Shared Investment ≈ 70 % of total development** – enables rapid local‑market “add‑on” development and lower long‑term cost of ownership. --- ## 3. Locale‑Specific Stack (30 % of product life‑cycle) ### 3.1 Curriculum Alignment Layer (Country‑Specific) | Country | Mandated Curriculum | Key Alignment Strategy | |---------|---------------------|------------------------| | **Vietnam** | VN/DP‑2020 (Vietnamese) | 1) Map each grade‑level learning objective to core engine. 2) Create **Curriculum‑Mapping API** that translates VN standards → internal learning paths. | | **Saudi Arabia** | Saqf/ Al‑Muʿallim (Arabic) | 1) Translate learning targets; 2) Embed **Islamic pedagogical cues** (reflection prompts, Q&A in Arabic script). | | **France** | LMD 2025 (French) | 1) Align with “Programme d’enseignement” (Primary, Secondary, Baccalauréat). 2) Leverage existing *Open Edition* standards (LOM, IEEE eLearning). | | **Kenya** | Kenya Basic Education Curriculum (KBE) | 1) Map to “Results‑Based" learning outcomes. 2) Provide **Bilingual** (English + Kiswahili) modes for rural schools. | ### 3.2 Language & Cultural Layer * **Unicode full support** + region‑specific fonts. * **Local Language Packs** (Vietnamese, Arabic, French, Kiswahili). * **Right‑to‑left rendering** (Arabic). * Cultural adaptation: images, examples, analogies tuned to local contexts. ### 3.3 Screen‑Time & Pedagogy Customization | Attitude | Local Response | Implementation | |----------|----------------|----------------| | **Vietnam** – high acceptance of screen time | Offer **Hybrid “Offline‑Download”** bundles that can be played on a simple media device. | • Offline content pack: PDF + SD‑card. | | **Saudi Arabia** – conservative screen use + religious values | Provide **“Silent” (no audio) modules** + parental dashboards that limit active minutes. | • Adaptive engine can throttle video length, schedule breaks. | | **France** – balanced digital literacy, high testing culture | Enable **Standardized‑Test Simulation** built in; auto‑grade quizzes. | • Built‑in “EPPE” (Epreuve) style modules. | | **Kenya** – mixed digital penetration | Offer **SMS‑driven micro‑learning** for low‑bandwidth regions. | • SMS API + push notifications. | ### 3.4 Assessment & Certification Compliance * Map to **official exam formats** (e.g., Vietnamese “Thi Học Trường” test series, Saudi “Al‑Mahfoudh” pattern, French “Brevet,” Kenyan “National Examination”). * Embed **Formative/ Summative** assessment blocks that can be auto‑scored. * Generate **Digital Diplomas / Certificates** that meet national accreditation bodies. --- ## 4. Channel & Procurement Model | Channel | Target Market | Key Features | Procurement Path | |---------|---------------|--------------|------------------| | **Public Schools** | State‑run schools in all 4 countries | Bulk license, no‑cost (subsidized) to teacher, data‑controlled | • e‑procurement portal (France, Vietnam, Saudi Arabia), bidding | | **Private & International Schools** | High‑income, bilingual schools | Tiered subscription, “Premium” content, teacher analytics | • Direct‑to‑customer website + partner sales | | **EdTech Partners** | Local content publishers, NGOs | White‑label API + content integration | • Co‑marketing, revenue share | | **Parents / Households** | Urban & peri‑urban parents | Pay‑as‑you‑go, minimal screen time, offline offline bundles | • Direct‑to‑consumer (Mobile money, e‑wallets) | | **Government Initiatives** | Digital Education grants | Full‑stack solution, local workforce training | • Co‑financing, government subsidies | --- ### 4.1 Government Procurement Touchpoints | Country | Digital Procurement System | Compliance Requirements | Notes | |---------|---------------------------|------------------------|-------| | **Vietnam** | e-Procurement Vietnam, GovCloud | Vendor accreditation, local staff requirement | Leverage local technical partner for on‑site support. | | **Saudi Arabia** | e‑Tenders (SHE-ARABIA) | Data privacy, Arabic language only | Build Arabic language UI first to pass mandatory linguistic vetting. | | **France** | BOAMP, e‑tender platform | GDPR, “French Data Sovereignty” | Host data on EU compliant cloud (France/Netherlands). | | **Kenya** | e‑Tenders Kenya | Anti‑corruption, open data | Use the “Kenya e‑Government” portal; propose open‑source modules. | --- ## 5. Pricing & Revenue Model | Segment | Pricing Model | Rationale | |---------|---------------|-----------| | **Public Schools** | Per‑student annual license (free + maintenance fee) | Subsidized funds from ministries | | **Private Schools** | Tiered per‑student/year (SaaS) | Recurring revenue | | **Parents** | Freemium (free access) + “Paid Bundle” (one‑time) | Encourage trial, low barrier | | **EdTech Partners** | Revenue Share (30/70) | Incentives for content integration | | **Government Grants** | Grant + revenue share | Funding for pilot in low‑income areas | **Goal:** Gross margin 55 % by year 3, with 3 million student‑licenses globally. --- ## 6. Go‑to‑Market Roadmap | Phase | Timeline | Milestones | |-------|----------|------------| | **Phase 1 – Foundations (Q3‑Q4 2026)** | • Regulatory & curriculum research
• Assemble local advisory boards (3 countries)
• Define core architecture & APIs
• Build MVP for a single curriculum (Vietnam) | | **Phase 2 – Pilot & Feedback (Q1‑Q2 2027)** | • 2 region pilots (Saudi, France)
• 1 pilot partner (Kenya NGO)
• Collect compliance scorecards, user data | | **Phase 3 – Scale & Diversify (Q3‑Q4 2027)** | • Expand to all 4 countries
• Publish 10 × core curriculum bundles
• Onboard 50 public school districts | | **Phase 4 – Optimisation & Growth (2028)** | • Machine‑learning refinement (curriculum mapping)
• Full‑market roll‑out
• Continuous product iteration | **Success Metrics (KPIs)** | KPI | Target | |-----|--------| | **Adoption** | 30 % of state schools in target region within 2 years | | **Engagement** | Average active minutes per user: < 1 hr/day in screen‑conservative markets | | **Academic Impact** | Passing rates improve by ≥ 10 % (pre‑ vs post‑implementation) | | **Revenue** | $5 M ARR by Q4 2028 | --- ## 7. Risk & Mitigation Matrix | Risk | Impact | Mitigation | |------|--------|------------| | **Curriculum Mis‑alignment** | Non‑approval | Continuous collaboration with ministries, local curriculum experts | | **Language Barrier** | Low adoption | Professional translation, local linguistic QA | | **Screen‑time Opposition** | Low engagement | Offer offline bundles, “silent” mode, parental dashboards | | **Procurement Delays** | Cash‑flow choke | Parallel direct‑to‑consumer sales; early tender engagement | | **Data Sovereignty Laws** | Legal risk | Cloud‑region compliance, data residency agreements | | **Platform Lock‑in** | Teacher & admin fatigue | Modular UI, teacher‑control dashboards, easy migration | --- ## 8. Local‑Partner Ecosystem | Partner Type | Role | Value‑Add | |--------------|------|-----------| | **Curriculum Content Labs** | Local content creators | Align content with standards | | **Translation & Localization Firms** | Language services | High‑quality UI, audio, subtitles | | **EdTech System Integrators** | LMS integration | Seamless SSO, analytics | | **Research Institutes** | Impact study | Evidence for grants | | **Local ISPs** | High‑speed connectivity in rural | Offline caching, video streaming | --- ## 9. Quick‑Start Checklist per Country 1. **Legal Gate‑Check** – Confirm data privacy, procurement regulations. 2. **Curriculum Mapp** – Complete learning objective mapping. 3. **Content Inventory** – Acquire/translate existing assets. 4. **Pilot Schools** – Secure 3–5 schools, sign NDA. 5. **Teacher Onboarding** – 2‑day training on adaptive platform. 6. **Parent Orientation** – Simple guide; mobile‑friendly FAQ. 7. **Feedback Loop** – Monthly data review, adjust algorithm. 8. **Government Liaison** – Submit a pilot proposal to ministry. 9. **Scale Plan** – Expand to next 10 schools within 90 days. --- ## 10. Bottom‑Line By **concentrating R&D on a robust, modular adaptive engine** and **building a lightweight, configurable compliance & localization stack** for each market, we can: * **Meet curriculum mandates** (Vietnam, Saudi, France, Kenya) without reinventing the wheel. * **Respect local attitudes** toward screen time and testing with configurable UX toggles. * **Navigate mixed procurement channels** through a unified supply‑chain & pricing strategy. * **Scale to millions of learners** while keeping margin high and acquisition cost low. **Strategic Pay‑off** – A world‑class, cross‑border adaptive‑learning platform that delivers equitable, high‑impact education—ready for the next wave of digital schooling in emerging & developed economies.
